# telnyx_global_ips (Data Source)

Lists global ips, with optional filters. Each item has the attributes of `telnyx_global_ip`.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `max_items` (Number) Stop reading after this many items. By default every page is read.

### Read-Only

- `global_ips` (Attributes List) The objects, in the order the API returns them. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--global_ips))

<a id="nestedatt--global_ips"></a>
### Nested Schema for `global_ips`

Read-Only:

- `created_at` (String) ISO 8601 formatted date-time indicating when the resource was created.
- `description` (String) A user specified description for the address.
- `id` (String) Identifies the resource.
- `ip_address` (String) The Global IP address.
- `name` (String) A user specified name for the address.
- `ports` (String) A Global IP ports grouped by protocol code. A JSON document; use `jsondecode()` to read it.
- `record_type` (String) Identifies the type of the resource.
- `updated_at` (String) ISO 8601 formatted date-time indicating when the resource was updated.
